senses.sense_definition: A model of internet marketing where advertisers pay a fee each time one of their ads is clicked.

examples.text: The company decided to increase its budget for <w>ppc</w> advertising to drive more traffic to the website.

target_lang_translations.zh: 公司决定增加<w>点击付费广告</w>的预算，以吸引更多流量到网站。

examples.text: Managing a successful <w>ppc</w> campaign requires careful keyword research and constant monitoring of performance metrics.

target_lang_translations.zh: 管理成功的<w>点击付费广告</w>活动需要仔细的关键词研究和对绩效指标的持续监控。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 一种网络营销模式，广告商在用户每次点击其广告时支付费用。

zh.target_lang_sense_clarification: 指代按点击次数计费的广告模式

senses.sense_definition: A candidate selected for a future election before the official campaign period begins.

examples.text: The local party association introduced their new <w>ppc</w> to the community during the town hall meeting.

target_lang_translations.zh: 当地党派协会在市政厅会议期间向社区介绍了他们新的<w>预选候选人</w>。

examples.text: As a <w>ppc</w>, the candidate spent months meeting with voters to understand their primary concerns before the election.

target_lang_translations.zh: 作为<w>预选候选人</w>，该候选人在选举前花了几个月时间与选民会面，以了解他们的主要关切。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 在正式竞选期开始前选定的未来选举候选人。

zh.target_lang_sense_clarification: 指在正式竞选前确定的候选人

senses.sense_definition: A graph showing the maximum possible output combinations of two goods that an economy can produce given its resources.

examples.text: The economics professor used a <w>ppc</w> to illustrate the concept of opportunity cost in production.

target_lang_translations.zh: 经济学教授使用<w>生产可能性曲线</w>来说明生产中的机会成本概念。

examples.text: Technological advancements can shift the <w>ppc</w> outward, allowing for greater production of both goods.

target_lang_translations.zh: 技术进步可以使<w>生产可能性曲线</w>向外移动，从而实现两种商品更大的产量。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 展示经济在给定资源下能够生产的两种商品的最大可能产出组合的图表。

zh.target_lang_sense_clarification: 经济学中描述资源配置效率的图表

senses.sense_definition: A family of RISC instruction set architectures designed by Apple, IBM, and Motorola.

examples.text: Older Macintosh computers were powered by <w>ppc</w> processors before the transition to Intel chips.

target_lang_translations.zh: 在转向英特尔芯片之前，较旧的麦金塔电脑由<w>PowerPC</w>处理器驱动。

examples.text: Developers had to optimize their software specifically for the <w>ppc</w> architecture to ensure compatibility.

target_lang_translations.zh: 开发人员必须专门针对<w>PowerPC</w>架构优化其软件，以确保兼容性。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 由苹果、IBM和摩托罗拉共同设计的精简指令集计算机架构系列。

zh.target_lang_sense_clarification: 一种特定的处理器指令集架构
